steps.name: transcribes the LibriSpeech clip in English
steps.check: (() => { const words = (t) => t.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z' ]+/g, ' ').split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean); const out = document.getElementById('transcript').cloneNode(true); out.querySelectorAll('.tag').forEach((t) => t.remove()); const got = words(out.textContent), want = words(SPEC.expected); const d = Array.from({ length: want.length + 1 }, (_, i) => [i]); for (let j = 1; j <= got.length; j++) d[0][j] = j; for (let i = 1; i <= want.length; i++) for (let j = 1; j <= got.length; j++) d[i][j] = Math.min(d[i - 1][j] + 1, d[i][j - 1] + 1, d[i - 1][j - 1] + (want[i - 1] === got[j - 1] ? 0 : 1)); const e = d[want.length][got.length]; return { fail: e > 1 && `${e} word errors: ${got.join(' ')}`, info: `${e} word errors, ${document.getElementById('stats').textContent}` }; })()
